transcript.en: Well, hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
So, Marco, how are you doing today?
I'm doing great and I'm really looking forward to our lesson because we're going to the eye doctor today.
transcript.zh: 我很好，非常期待今天的课，因为今天我们要去看眼科医生。

transcript.en: Okay, so we've got an elementary lesson about going to the eye doctor.
transcript.zh: 好的，我们有一节关于看眼科医生的初级课程。

transcript.en: Well, let's get started then with our vocabulary preview.
transcript.zh: 好，那我们从词汇预览开始吧。

transcript.en: We have three words today in our vocabulary preview.
transcript.zh: 今天的词汇预览有三个词。

transcript.en: All three words come from our dialogue.
transcript.zh: 三个词都来自我们的对话。
第一个词是 struggle（挣扎/费力）。

transcript.en: So, Marco, when I struggle to do something, what does that mean?
transcript.zh: 马可，当我说 struggle to do something，是什么意思？

transcript.en: It means that you have a hard time so you can't really do it very quickly.
transcript.zh: 意思是你很费劲，没法很快做好。

transcript.en: So you have to try really hard.
transcript.zh: 所以你必须非常努力才行。

transcript.en: You have to try really hard.
Yeah, to do something that's difficult.
Okay, our next word is blurry.
transcript.zh: 好的，下一个词是 blurry（模糊的）。

transcript.en: Whenever something is blurry, you can't really see it well.
transcript.zh: 当某物 blurry 时，你看不太清楚。

transcript.en: Okay, and our final word is prescription.
transcript.zh: 好的，最后一个词是 prescription（处方/验光单）。

transcript.en: Often, when you go to the doctor and you need some medicine, he writes out a prescription.
transcript.zh: 通常，当你去看医生需要药时，他会给你开处方。

transcript.en: It's like a paper that says all the medicine that you need and then you can go to the drug store and buy it.
transcript.zh: 就像一张纸，上面写着你要的药，然后你可以去药店买。

transcript.en: Okay, so those three words you'll hear in today's dialogue and I think it's time we listen to the dialogue.
transcript.zh: 好的，这三个词你会在今天的对话中听到，我想是时候听对话了。

transcript.en: What seems to be the problem?
Well, I think I might need glasses.
transcript.zh: 嗯，我觉得我可能需要配眼镜。

transcript.en: I'm getting headaches and I really struggle to see things that are far away.
transcript.zh: 我经常头疼，看远处的东西真的很费劲。

transcript.en: Sounds like you might be farsighted.
Okay, then cover your left eye and read the chart in front of you.
transcript.zh: 好的，遮住你的左眼，读你面前的视力表。

transcript.en: And I can't quite make out the other symbol, but I think it's the peace sign.
transcript.zh: 我分辨不出另一个符号，但我觉得是和平标志。

transcript.en: Wow, Arthur, you're as blind as a bat.
transcript.zh: 哇，亚瑟，你真是瞎得跟蝙蝠一样。

transcript.en: My vision is really blurry at times.
transcript.zh: 我的视力有时候真的很模糊。

transcript.en: Head over to the other room and pick out some frames while I fill out your prescription.
transcript.zh: 去隔壁房间挑镜框吧，我来给你开验光单。

transcript.en: Well, this guy really has poor vision, hey?
transcript.zh: 嗯，这家伙视力真差，对吧？

transcript.en: I've walked into the bathroom, the men's bathroom, actually, instead of the women's bathroom and that's not because I wasn't wearing my glasses.
transcript.zh: 我也曾走错过卫生间，走进了男卫生间而不是女卫生间，那还不是因为我没戴眼镜。

transcript.en: It's because you weren't paying attention.
Okay, let's take a look today at our language takeaway.
transcript.zh: 好的，来看看今天的语言要点。

transcript.en: The first word on our language takeaway for today is 20-20 vision.
transcript.zh: 今天语言要点的第一个词是 20-20 vision（视力正常）。

transcript.en: It means that you have perfect vision.
So I usually wear glasses as well.
But yeah, people that have 20-20 vision don't need glasses.
transcript.zh: 不过是的，有正常视力的人不需要眼镜。
下一个词是 far-sighted（远视的）。

transcript.en: So, if I'm far-sighted, I can't see very well, right?
transcript.zh: 那如果我是远视，我看不太清楚，对吧？

transcript.en: So if you're far-sighted, you can't see things that are near.
transcript.zh: 如果你是远视，你看不清近处的东西。

transcript.en: So you can see things that are far away, but things that are close are blurry.
transcript.zh: 你能看清远处的东西，但近处的东西是模糊的。

transcript.en: You can see things that are close well.
So our next word is make out.
transcript.zh: 下一个词是 make out（辨认/看清）。

transcript.en: That's kind of a funny little phrase.
transcript.zh: 这是个有点好玩的小短语。

transcript.en: And let's listen to a few examples of this phrase so we can understand how it's used.
transcript.zh: 来听几个例子，了解这个短语的用法。

transcript.en: I can't make out what this says.
transcript.zh: 我看不清这上面写的什么。

transcript.en: If you look carefully, you can almost make out a few of the stars in the sky.
transcript.zh: 如果你仔细看，你几乎能辨认出天上的几颗星星。

transcript.en: Can you see what's written on the sign there?
transcript.zh: 你能看到那边牌子上写的什么吗？

transcript.en: I can't quite make it out.
So basically, make out is to see clearly.
transcript.zh: 所以基本上，make out 就是看清楚。

transcript.en: And our last word for language takeaway today is blind as a bat.
transcript.zh: 今天语言要点的最后一个词是 blind as a bat（瞎得像蝙蝠一样）。

transcript.en: So this is a really funny sounding expression.
transcript.zh: 这是一个听起来很好笑的表达。

transcript.en: One of these weird English idioms.
transcript.zh: 英语中那些奇怪的习惯用语之一。

transcript.en: It's a really common expression that just means that you can't see.
transcript.zh: 这是一个非常常见的表达，意思是你看不见。

transcript.en: So it's not like you actually are blind, right?
transcript.zh: 不是说你真的瞎了，对吧？

transcript.en: But you just really can't see very well.
transcript.zh: 只是你真的看不太清楚。

transcript.en: We saw four great words today in our language takeaway.
transcript.zh: 今天的语言要点我们看了四个很棒的词。

transcript.en: Now I think we can listen to our dialogue another time.
transcript.zh: 现在我想我们可以再听一遍对话了。

transcript.en: But this time, it's going to be slower so we can pick up all these great words that we just talked about.
transcript.zh: 但这次会慢一些，这样我们就能听清刚才讨论的所有这些好词。

transcript.en: What seems to be the problem?
Well, I think I might need glasses.
transcript.zh: 嗯，我觉得我可能需要配眼镜。

transcript.en: I'm getting headaches and I really struggle to see things that are far away.
transcript.zh: 我经常头疼，看远处的东西真的很费劲。

transcript.en: Sounds like you may be farsighted.
Cover your left eye and read the chart in front of you.
transcript.zh: 遮住左眼，读你面前的视力表。

transcript.en: X, E, R, 3, question mark, and I can't quite make out the other symbol, but I think it's a peace sign.
transcript.zh: X、E、R、3、问号，还有一个符号我看不太清，但我觉得是和平标志。

transcript.en: Wow, Arthur, you're as blind as a bat.
transcript.zh: 哇，亚瑟，你真是瞎得跟蝙蝠一样。

transcript.en: My vision is really blurry at times.
transcript.zh: 我的视力有时候真的很模糊。

transcript.en: Head on over to the other room and pick out some frames while I fill out your prescription.
transcript.zh: 去隔壁房间挑镜框吧，我来给你开验光单。

transcript.en: And with this, we can start now with putting it together.
transcript.zh: 接下来我们可以开始整合运用了。

transcript.en: So we saw a couple of useful phrases in this dialogue, and I think we can show you how to use these phrases in a few different ways.
transcript.zh: 我们在对话中看到了一些有用的短语，我想可以给大家展示如何以不同方式使用它们。

transcript.en: The first one that we have today is, what seems to be.
transcript.zh: 今天的第一个是 what seems to be。

transcript.en: So we heard in the dialogue, the doctor said, what seems to be the problem.
transcript.zh: 我们在对话中听到医生说，what seems to be the problem。

transcript.en: We can use this same expression in a number of different ways.
transcript.zh: 我们可以用多种不同方式使用这个表达。

transcript.en: What seems to be the problem?
What seems to be the matter?
What seems to be the trouble?
Okay, so with these examples, we can see how we can use the phrase, what seems to be, in many different ways.
transcript.zh: 好的，通过这些例子，我们看到 how 可以用多种方式使用 what seems to be 这个短语。

transcript.en: Yeah, it's a great way of asking, what's the problem?
transcript.zh: 是的，这是问「什么问题」的一个很好的方式。

transcript.en: So now, let's take a look at another phrase.
We heard in the dialogue, the doctor said, head on over to the other room.
transcript.zh: 我们在对话中听到医生说了 head on over to the other room。

transcript.en: And with this phrase, head on, we can combine it with other prepositions to indicate another place.
transcript.zh: 用这个短语 head on，我们可以搭配其他介词来指示另一个地方。

transcript.en: Okay, so for example, we can say, head on into the house, it's gonna rain soon.
transcript.zh: 好的，比如我们可以说，快进屋吧，马上要下雨了。

transcript.en: Or we can say, hey guys, let's head on out to the park.
transcript.zh: 或者我们可以说，嘿伙计们，我们出发去公园吧。

transcript.en: Or I can also say, head on up to my room, I'll be there in a second.
transcript.zh: 我也可以说，先上我房间去，我马上到。

transcript.en: So why don't we listen to our dialogue and maybe we'll hear them again.
transcript.zh: 那我们再听一遍对话吧，也许还能再听到它们。

transcript.zh: 我经常头疼，看远处的东西真的很费劲。

transcript.en: Sounds like you might be farsighted.
Okay then, cover your left eye and read the chart in front of you.
transcript.zh: 好的，遮住左眼，读你面前的视力表。

transcript.zh: X、E、R、3、问号，还有一个符号我看不太清，但我觉得是和平标志。

transcript.zh: 哇，亚瑟，你真是瞎得跟蝙蝠一样。

transcript.zh: 我的视力有时候真的很模糊。

transcript.en: Okay then, head over to the other room and pick out some frames while I fill out your prescription.
transcript.zh: 好的，去隔壁房间挑镜框吧，我来给你开验光单。

transcript.en: Okay, so talking about going to the eye doctor today, I have a question for our listeners.
transcript.zh: 好的，今天聊了看眼科医生，我有一个问题要问听众。

transcript.en: What's it called when you can't distinguish colors?
transcript.zh: 当你无法分辨颜色的时候，这叫什么？

transcript.en: So like when you can't tell the difference between red and blue and green.
transcript.zh: 就是当你分不清红色、蓝色和绿色的时候。

transcript.en: So what is that condition called?
So there's like a technical term.
So we'll be looking for it on our comments page and be sure to, if you know the answer,
transcript.zh: 我们会在评论页面留意，如果你知道答案，

transcript.en: Also, if you have questions about today's lesson or any other lesson, please come and visit our website and ask us.
transcript.zh: 另外，如果对今天的课或其他任何课有疑问，请来访问我们的网站向我们提问。

transcript.en: Yeah, we hope to see you there, but until then it's goodbye.
transcript.zh: 是的，希望在那里见到你们，但在此之前，再见了。

dialogue.en: A: What seems to be the problem?
B: Well, I think I might need glasses.
dialogue.zh: B：嗯，我想我可能需要配眼镜了。

dialogue.en: B: I'm getting headaches, and I really struggle to see things that are far away.
dialogue.zh: B：我经常头疼，而且看不清远处的东西。

dialogue.en: B: But I have always had 20/20 vision.
dialogue.zh: B：但我以前视力一直是20/20啊。

dialogue.en: A: Sounds like you may be far-sighted.
A: OK, then, cover your left eye and read the chart in front of you.
dialogue.zh: A：好的，遮住你的左眼，读一下你面前的视力表。

dialogue.en: B: Mmm... X, E, R, 3, a question mark, and I can't quite make out the other symbol but I think it's the peace sign.
dialogue.zh: B：嗯…X, E, R, 3，一个问号，还有一个符号我看不太清，但我觉得是个和平标志。

dialogue.en: A: You're as blind as a bat!
dialogue.zh: A：你简直瞎得跟蝙蝠一样！

dialogue.en: B: Yeah, I know, my vision is really blurry at times.
dialogue.zh: B：是啊，我知道，我看东西有时候真的很模糊。

dialogue.en: A: Ok then, head on over to the other room and pick out some frames while I fill out your prescription.
